1.1: This Simon Peter talkin'—servant and apostle of Jesus Christ—writin' to the folks who got the same precious faith as us, made right with God through our Savior Jesus Christ.
1.2: May grace and peace hit your life even harder, the more you get to know God and Jesus, our Lord.
1.3: His divine power already hooked us up with everything we need for life and godliness. And all of it flows through knowin' Him—the One who called us with glory and purpose.
1.4: Through that, He gave us promises so big, so valuable, it's wild. And through those promises, we get to tap into God's nature, and dip out the trap of this world's mess—the lust, the corruption, all that.
1.5: And 'cause of all that, make it your full-time job to build on your faith: Start with virtue, Then add knowledge,
1.6: To knowledge, add self-control, To self-control, add perseverance, To perseverance, add godliness,
1.7: To godliness, add brotherly love, And finally—top it off with real love.
1.8: If all that's in you, and growin'? You won't be spiritually dry or empty when it comes to knowin' Jesus Christ.
1.9: But if you missin' that stuff? You blind. You forgot what Jesus already cleaned you from.
1.10: So fam—lock in. Make sure your calling and election stay solid. If you do all this, you won't fall off.
1.11: And when it's all said and done, you gon' walk straight into God's Kingdom with open doors—Jesus waitin' for you with glory.
1.12: That's why I'ma keep remindin' y'all—even if you already know and standin' in the truth.
1.13: As long as I'm still here in this body, I'ma keep stirrin' y'all up. Gotta keep y'all sharp.
1.14: I know I ain't gon' be here much longer—Jesus already showed me how I was gon' go.
1.15: But best believe, I'm makin' sure y'all remember this stuff even after I'm gone. I ain't leavin' y'all empty.
1.16: We ain't follow no made-up fairy tales when we told y'all about Jesus' power and return. We seen His majesty ourselves.
1.17: He got glory and honor from the Father when that voice came from heaven sayin', "This My Son, My Beloved—He got My full approval."
1.18: We heard that voice too—right from the sky—when we was with Him on that holy mountain.
1.19: So now we got the prophetic word confirmed—and y'all would be smart to pay attention to it. It's like a light shinin' in a dark room, until the day fully breaks and the morning star rises in your heart.
1.20: First thing to know: no prophecy in Scripture comes from somebody's personal interpretation.
1.21: Prophecy ain't never been about what a man wanted to say. It's straight from God—spoken through folks who were moved by the Holy Spirit.

2.1: Just like there was false prophets back in the day, there gon' be false teachers now—slidin' in quiet with dangerous lies. Some even gon' deny the same Lord who bought 'em. And trust, they bringin' destruction on they own heads.
2.2: And plenty folks gon' follow they wild ways. Because of them, people gon' trash-talk the truth.
2.3: Outta greed, they gon' manipulate you with slick talk. But just know—judgment been waitin'. Destruction ain't sleepin'. It's on the way.
2.4: Think about it—God ain't even spare the angels that wilded out. He tossed 'em into darkness, chained up 'til judgment time.
2.5: He ain't spare the world before the flood either—but He did save Noah, a real one, who preached righteousness, while the rest drowned in they wickedness.
2.6: Sodom and Gomorrah? Burned down. Turned to ash as a warning for anybody tryna live foul.
2.7: But He saved Lot, a righteous dude who was fed up with the filth he saw every day.
2.8: That man's soul was tormented daily, livin' in the middle of all that mess.
2.9: So trust—God knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and how to hold the wicked for the day of judgment.
2.10: Especially the ones wildin' out in the flesh, full of lust, and disrespectin' authority. They cocky, arrogant, and ain't even scared to run their mouth about things above their rank.
2.11: Meanwhile, even angels—way more powerful—don't talk reckless like that. They stay in position before the Lord.
2.12: But these fake teachers? Like wild animals, made to get caught and taken out. Talkin' down on what they don't understand—and they gon' get wrecked by the same foolishness they love.
2.13: Their reward? The same as all unrighteous folks—disgrace. They party in the daytime like sin is a flex. They messy at your table, playin' fake while smilin' in your face.
2.14: Eyes full of lust, hearts trained in greed, always lookin' for someone unstable to pull down with them. They cursed.
2.15: They dipped from the right path and followed Balaam—who sold out for a check.
2.16: But even Balaam got called out—by his own donkey! The animal had to speak up to stop the prophet from actin' a fool. Imagine that.
2.17: These folks like dry wells—ain't got nothin' to offer. Storm clouds tossed around with no direction. Darkness is their final stop.
2.18: They talk big, loud, and slick—but it's all hollow. They pull in people who just escaped the mess, temptin' 'em back through lust and wild living.
2.19: They talk about freedom, but they stuck themselves—slaves to sin. Whoever controls you? That's your master.
2.20: And if somebody escaped the world through Jesus, but ends up tangled up in that same mess again? The fall back is worse than the first.
2.21: It would've been better if they never knew the truth, than to know it and turn away like it ain't mean nothin'.
2.22: Just like the saying goes: "A dog goin' back to its own vomit," and "a clean pig runnin' straight back to the mud." Nasty, but true.

3.1: Yo, beloved, I'm writin' this second letter to y'all—reminding you to keep your minds pure—just a reminder, plain and simple.
3.2: So you don't forget them words the holy prophets dropped before, or the commands we apostles of the Lord and Savior passed on to y'all.
3.3: First off, know this: in the last days, there gonna be scoffers—folks followin' their own wild desires,
3.4: Who gonna be like, "Where's the promise of His comin'? Since our forefathers slept, everything's been goin' on just the same ever since creation."
3.5: But they straight up forget—by God's word, the heavens got made long ago, and the earth came up outta the water and was set in the water.
3.6: And that same word wiped out the world that used to be, floodin' it all with water.
3.7: But now, the heavens and the earth that we got? They're kept safe by that same word—but they're reserved for fire, 'til the day God comes to judge and doom all the ungodly.
3.8: But listen up, beloved: don't forget one thing—one day with the Lord is like a thousand years, and a thousand years is like one day.
3.9: The Lord ain't slow with His promise—as some might think—but He's patient with us. He ain't willin' anyone to perish; He wants everybody to come to repentance.
3.10: But mark this—the day of the Lord gon' hit like a thief in the night. The heavens gonna vanish with a mighty sound, and the elements will melt away in scorching heat. Every bit of earth and all its works will burn up.
3.11: So, since all these things are gonna vanish, what kind of people should you be? Walk in holy conduct and godliness,
3.12: Always lookin' and hustlin' for the day of God—when the heavens go up in flames and the elements melt away in heat.
3.13: Yet even with all that fire comin', we, by His promise, are lookin' forward to new heavens and a new earth—where righteousness truly dwells.
3.14: So, beloved, as you wait for all these things, be extra diligent to be found by Him in peace—spotless and blameless.
3.15: And remember: the Lord's patience is salvation. Our brother Paul, with the wisdom He got, wrote this out to you,
3.16: Just like in all his letters. He talks about these things—even if some parts are hard to get—and warns that untaught, unstable folks will twist 'em for their own downfall, just like they twist the rest of the Scriptures.
3.17: So y'all, since you know this ahead of time, be careful not to lose your own steadfastness. Don't get led astray by the errors of the wicked.
3.18: Instead, keep growin' in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
3.19: To Him be all the glory now and forever. Amen.
